tasks.subject: Task 0: Typed AST datatype module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Parameterized typed AST (Texp a / Tpat a) mirroring elaboration-reachable Abs.Exp/pattern forms; annotation = Type s during inference, CType after freezing.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Typed.hs", "wok.cabal", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options='-p TypedAst'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Texp/Tpat Functor/Foldable/Traversable", "one constructor per Abs.Exp form", "aliases TExprS/TExpr/TPatS/TPat", "TypedAst passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: generalizeTyped + whole-tree zonk
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Freeze a TExprS tree to TExpr with the SAME freezeQuantify mapping as the scheme, in one pass at the top-level outer level.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options='-p Zonk'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["generalizeTyped returns (Scheme, TExpr)", "poly nodes share CTGen", "mono nodes concrete", "schemeVars read after tree freeze", "Zonk passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: inferExprW and patterns build typed nodes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every expression/pattern inference case returns its typed node alongside the Type s it already computes.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options='-p InferTyped'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["inferExprW/Checked return typed node, all cases", "patterns return TPatS", "annotation == returned type", "InferTyped passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: thread + freeze typed bodies; extend TypedDecl
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Carry each equation's typed body to its top-level generalize, freeze the whole tree there, surface on TypedDecl.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options='-p TypedDeclBody'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["TypedDecl has tdParams/tdWhere/tdBody", "freeze once at top finalizeGroup", "inner groups unfrozen", "TypedDeclBody passes"]}
```
